## Activity

During December 2022, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 386 captures as part of its site activity. This figure represents the total number of images submitted for review during the month. The activity report provides the basis for assessing image quality and grading outcomes across the service.

## Image quality

Of the 386 captures, 24 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.2. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is reported separately from the grading outcome. Image quality should continue to be monitored through routine review of capture performance and reporting.

## Grading

Grading identified 79 referable results. The median lag between capture and completion of grading was 2. This measure indicates the typical interval for the reporting process during December 2022. Together, the activity, image quality, and grading figures provide a summary of service performance at Harbour Eye Clinic for the month.
